senses.gloss:
(औ) दुहौ r. 2nd cl. (दोग्धि) 3rd pers. plu. (दुहन्ति)
To milk.
(इर) दुहिर r. 1st cl. (दोहति)
1 To hurt, to afflict, to give pain.
2 To kill.

m. (धुक्)
A milker.
E.
दुह, and क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्)
1 Relinquishing, parting with.
2 Milking.
E.
दुह to milk, शतृ aff.

m. (-तिः)
A son-in-law, a daughter's husband.
E.
दुहितृ a daughter, in the possessive case, and पति a husband.

f. (-ता)
A daughter.
E.
दुह to milk, (the mother,) Uṇādi affix तृच्, and इट् inserted.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
To be milked, milkable.
E.
दुह to milk, affix क्यप्; also दोह्य.
